title: Tech's biggest CEOs and founders lost $61 billion during the stock market's plunge in October - here's who got hit hard (FB, AMZN, AAPL, NFLX, GOOG, BIDU, BABA)
text: Tech's biggest CEOs and founders lost $61 billion during the stock market's plunge in October — here's who got hit hard (FB, AMZN, AAPL, NFLX, GOOG, BIDU, BABA) By Ethel Jiang Nov 1, 2018, 7:14 pm 11 pts October was a rough month for billionaires in the tech sector, who saw their net worth plummet as stocks took a hammering. According to Bloomberg data, the CEOs and founders of the most popular tech companies "FAANG+BAT" lost $61 billion in October. The tech-heavy Nasdaq index plunged 9.2%,…
